# GEO report: Millstone Bakery

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 100/100, Strong

Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points).
How it's calculated: low = 23 ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. High = (23 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 100.

This is a small static HTML site. I read every file and sampled all 4 routes. No scored rule has a problem. The one thing code can't show is whether a CDN or firewall in front of the site blocks real crawlers.

## Live check

- **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

Nothing is broken. The biggest unknown is below.

### 1. Confirm real crawlers can get through your host
- **Why it matters:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall blocks search crawlers.
- **Where:** outside the repository. Hosting or CDN settings.
- **What the code says:** `robots.txt:1-2`: `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** stays 100. This only confirms the result.

## All results

| Rule | What it checks | Code | Where |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `robots.txt:1-8`, plain text and well-formed |
| GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `robots.txt:1-3` allows all, blocks only `/members/`. `GPTBot` (a training crawler) is blocked at `robots.txt:5-6`, which matches `trainingCrawlers: "block"` and isn't scored |
| GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Clear | 3 public routes have no noindex. `members/index.html:9` has noindex on purpose and isn't in the sitemap |
| GEO-015 | Absolute canonical | Clear | `index.html:8`, `breads.html:8`, `classes.html:8`, all on `https://www.millstonebakery.example` |
| GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Static HTML, text is in the markup |
| GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD in the project |
| GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `sitemap.xml:1-6`, referenced at `robots.txt:8` |
| GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Clear | All 4 pages have `lang="en"`, a unique title and a description |
| GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Clear | Plain `<a href>` nav in all pages, for example `index.html:12` |
| GEO-017 | No snippet blocking | Clear | Only `data-nosnippet` on one element, `breads.html:16`, which is a deliberate choice |
| GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | Read all 4 pages. The only image has alt text at `index.html:16`, and every page has a title |
| GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | No mobile app declared |
| GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not present, and not scored |
| GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not an app |

## Other problems found

None found.

## Worth considering

- **Label the business with structured data:** `index.html:6`: `Millstone Bakery, sourdough in York`. There's no `Bakery`/`LocalBusiness` JSON-LD. Adding the name, town and URL might help machines identify the business. Add the address, phone number and hours too, but only once the pages state them.
- **Say where and when to visit:** `index.html:7`: `baking fresh every morning`. No page gives an address, opening hours or a way to contact the bakery, which is the first thing a local visitor wants.
- **Explain how pre-ordering works:** `index.html:15`: `Pre-order for weekend collection.` Nothing says how to pre-order, by when, or at what price. Add that as text.
- **List the loaves:** `breads.html:15`: `Over twenty loaves through the week`. Only two are named. Listing them with descriptions, or giving each its own page, backs up the claim.
- **Add class details:** `classes.html:15`: `Book early, because places go quickly.` There are no dates, prices, group size or booking link. Add them as text, and as `Event` data if the dates are fixed.
- **Link between related pages in the body:** `classes.html:15`. Classes and breads don't link to each other in the page text, only through the nav.
- **Add `<lastmod>` to the sitemap:** `sitemap.xml:3`: `<url><loc>https://www.millstonebakery.example/</loc></url>`. Add real modified dates.
- **Add social tags:** `index.html:8`. There are no `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image` tags, so link previews have nothing to show.
- **Check the image file:** `index.html:16`: `/img/loaves.jpg`. The file isn't in this repository, so confirm it exists, because a broken image would lose that content.

## Can't tell from code

- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. To check, run `geopilot logs <access log>`, which compares real crawlers against their published addresses.
- **Live-only checks:** status codes, redirects and `X-Robots-Tag` headers (GEO-011, GEO-014, GEO-015) need a live scan. They don't change the code results.

## Assumptions

- The origin `https://www.millstonebakery.example` comes from `geo.config.json`. It is a placeholder `.example` domain, so replace it with the real domain before launch.
- `members/` is meant to stay private, so I didn't treat its noindex or its robots block as a problem.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command if you want any of the ideas above applied. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
